tweet: "I dreamt of colorful butterflies."
"Im on my 5th day of my new meds (Escitalopram & Olanzapine). I would say that there are some improvements. I could eat na. Unlike before talaga, no appetite at all. I guess thats the Olanzapine."
"I hope everyone reading this heals from all this trauma & mental health issues. Dont be afraid of therapy and medication."

"One of the biggest reasons people often dont seek help for mental health is the thought of being put on medication due to the stigma. I refuse to feel guilty if they would help my brain cope with life. 💙"
"But I gotta trust the process. If it would help me heal mentally and emotionally, I guess weight gain is the least of my concern."
"People who tried the drug said that they gained a LOT of weight in just a short period of time which I dont like thats why I was kinda hesitant to take it."
"Olanzapine is also known to stimulate appetite according to doc. I havent been eating properly for weeks though I cant really say if theres any changes with my weight haha."
"Olanzapine which is an antipsychotic drug used to treat Schizophrenia, etc. They say its a mood stabilizer and based on what Ive read it could also treat depression."

"According to my Psychiatrist I have a very minimal improvement despite increasing the dosage of my antidepressant. She decided to shift my medication from Sertraline to Escitalopram. Continue with Clonazepam for anxiety attacks. Then she added another medication; HTTPURL"
"This Rivotril used to make me feel sleepy when I first took it, at least for the first 2 weeks. But now, I can hardly sleep again. Its past 3am, now what? HTTPURL"
"I am on Clonazepam but can hardly sleep. 😒"
"that feeling didnt last long. I easily get tired not physically but mentally and emotionally. But the fact that I was able to convince myself to go out is a good improvement. Fighting. 🙌🏻"

"Psychiatrist said that I need to go out more. So, I went out today with the whole fam (followed safety protocols). Today was one of the first times I ate properly since my episodes. Today was one of my first times I felt "okay". But.."
"I dont think I am okay today."

"18 days on meds for MDD. My psychiatrist raised the dose of my antidepressant from 50mg to 75mg. Are the meds working? I dont know. Cant say yet. It may really take time to kick in according to her. #Mentalhealth #MentalHealthAwareness #mentalillness #depression #usaptayo"
"Kinda worried about my work because I dont have any sick leave credits. Baka papelan ako. But what can I do? 😔"

"Had a session with my Psychiatrist today. I had to ask for leave extension for at least couple of days lang naman but she advised me to have 2 more weeks off. We had psycho educ / therapy done. And my Sertraline is increased from 50mg to 75mg a day."
"I am aware that Im not alone battling with this type of mental struggle. To anyone, to you, youre not alone. Yakap. 💙"
"They say acceptance and awareness are the 2 steps towards change. I have accepted that Im not mentally healthy. I may not be totally well but I know Ill be better."

"Destigmatizing mental illness:   Hello! I am diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder and struggle with regular anxiety attacks. I've become someone who I don't recognize. Where there was once enthusiasm and a sense of well-being, now there is only profound sadness."
